ayahs.1: Main is shehar ki qasam khaata hoon.
ayahs.2: Aur aap is shehar mein muqeem hain.
ayahs.3: Aur (qasam hai) insaani baap aur aulaad ki.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan hum ne insaan ko (badi) mashaqqat mein paida kiya hai.
ayahs.5: Kya yeh guman karta hai ke yeh kisi ke bas mein hi nahin?
ayahs.6: Kehta (phirta) hai ke main ne to bahut kuchh maal kharch kar daala.
ayahs.7: Kya (yoon) samajhta hai ke kisi ne use dekha (hi) nahin?
ayahs.8: Kya hum ne us ki do aankhen nahin banaeen.
ayahs.9: Aur zabaan aur do hont (nahin banaye).
ayahs.10: Hum ne dikha diye us ko dono raaste.
ayahs.11: So us se na ho saka ke ghaati mein daakhil hota.
ayahs.12: Aur kya samjha ke ghaati hai kya?
ayahs.13: Kisi gardan (ghulam, laundi) ko aazaad karna.
ayahs.14: Ya bhookh wale din khaana khilaana.
ayahs.17: Phir un logon mein se ho jaata jo imaan laate aur ek doosre ko sabr ki aur reham karne ki wasiyat karte hain.
ayahs.18: Yehi log hain daayen baazu wale (khush-bakhti wale).
ayahs.19: Aur jin logon ne hamari aayaton ke saath kufr kiya, yeh kam-bakhti wale hain.
ayahs.20: Inhi par aag hogi jo chaaron taraf se gheri hui hogi.
